ruleDefinitions.name: ClickOnce Trust Prompt Tampering
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to the ClickOnce trust prompt registry key in order to enable an installation from different locations such as the Internet. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\MICROSOFT\\\\\\\.NETFramework\\\\Security\\\\TrustManager\\\\PromptingLevel\\\\.*") AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\Internet$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\LocalIntranet$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\MyComputer$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\TrustedSites$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\UntrustedSites$")) AND Details = "Enabled")
